verdict.rationale: Segment documents Data Storage Destinations that store your raw Segment data in data warehouses, AWS S3 and Google Cloud Storage. Separately, the Profile API lets you programmatically query entire user and account objects, including external_ids, traits and events. Together these give a real path to getting data out, but the evidence never names the export file formats or offers a documented complete-export or offboarding process. missing for 10: explicit open-format specification (e.g. JSON/Parquet) for exports, documented bulk export of all workspace data (profiles, audiences, config), offboarding/account-exit guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
